notes.title: Initial Settings Fix...
notes.notes:
Sorry folks! Swap Fire shipped with all of its content unlocked, ruining the game's intended buildup and pacing. This should set things right, as long as you haven't opened the game yet.

Thank you for playing!

- Jeremy
